study type: economic evaluation alongside a multicentre pragmatic randomised controlled trial
exposure: closed incision negative pressure wound therapy (ci-NPWT)
cohort: Obese women (pre-pregnancy body mass index ≥30 kg/m2) giving birth by elective/semi-urgent caesarean section.
finding: The study found that ci-NPWT was associated with higher costs and no significant difference in QALYs compared to standard dressings, suggesting it is unlikely to be cost-effective for preventing SSI in this population.
